evidence: Huu Tiep Lake, also known as B-52 Lake, is a small artificial freshwater lake situated in the ward of Ngoc Ha, Hanoi. Originally part of a larger river, most of the waterway was filled in 1994 to create residential areas, leaving Huu Tiep Lake and another unnamed lake nearby, separated by 55 Hoang Hoa Tham lane.
